say:1:1320630001:1.text: What happened to Callan? He's not moving again...
say:1:1320630001:1.source_cn: 哥哥……哥哥他怎么了？他又不动了……

say:2:1320630002:1.text: Some welded parts are smoking! We need to fix him up! Get out of the way, Missy!
say:2:1320630002:1.source_cn: 小姑娘，他身上焊接处在冒烟呢，得赶快抢修！你们都让开，...

say:4:1320630003:1.text: How could this have happened? Didn't Callan hear Carolina and start moving again?
say:4:1320630003:1.source_cn: 怎么、怎么突然会这样呀？铐兰不是听到卡列琳娜的呼唤，重...

say:5:1320630004:1.text: Callan's lingering soul fought against my magic... He resisted the return to his original body. The magic was causing his essence to tear, so I had no choice but to release him before it was too late.
say:5:1320630004:1.source_cn: 铐兰的残魂在抗拒我的魔法……他不想离开回到自己的身体里...

say:6:1320630005:1.text: Unfortunately, there were still some adverse reactions to the magic...
say:6:1320630005:1.source_cn: 但是，看起来仍然产生了一些反噬效果……

choice_prompt:7:1320630005.text: Unfortunately, there were still some adverse reactions to the magic...
choice_prompt:7:1320630005.source_cn: 但是，看起来仍然产生了一些反噬效果……

say:9:1320630008:0.text: I just can't fathom why any tormented soul wouldn't seek peace... What is he clinging on to?
say:9:1320630008:0.source_cn: 我不明白，怎么会有饱受折磨的灵魂不想回归安宁……他在坚...

say:11:1320630009:1.text: Whoa! This fella... Everyone, come take a look!
say:11:1320630009:1.source_cn: 嚯，这小家伙……娃子们，你们来瞧瞧！

say:12:1320630010:1.text: What did you find, Master Hugin?
say:12:1320630010:1.source_cn: 呼金先生，您发现什么了？

say:13:1320630011:0.text: When inspecting the parts earlier, I discovered this golem had a locked compartment in his chest.
say:13:1320630011:0.source_cn: 之前检查部件时，我发现这机械人偶的胸膛里有一个上锁的空腔。

say:14:1320630012:1.text: After the explosion just now, the lock portion protecting the outer shell was broken, so I was able to get this little gadget out of his chest.
say:14:1320630012:1.source_cn: 瞧，刚才爆炸之后，保护外壳的锁芯被震坏了，所以我才能把...

say:16:1320630014:0.text: This is a sound loom. It's an amazing invention created by my people to record sounds.
say:16:1320630014:0.source_cn: 这是织言机，是我族人发明的伟大机械，我们发明他们，用来...

choice_prompt:18:1320630014.text: This is a sound loom. It's an amazing invention created by my people to record sounds.
choice_prompt:18:1320630014.source_cn: 这是织言机，是我族人发明的伟大机械，我们发明他们，用来记录声音。

say:19:1320630015:1.text: Well, the essence of sound is vibration. My people were able to quantify sound into different frequencies of vibration. By rearranging those vibrations with metal foil, we can reproduce them...
say:19:1320630015:1.source_cn: 声音的本质是震动，你们知道吧？我的族人试着把声音量化成...

say:20:1320630016:1.text: That's how the sound loom was born. As long as the frequency recorder is intact, it can record sounds of the past, whether it's a century-old piano song or the cry of a newborn baby!
say:20:1320630016:1.source_cn: 于是织言机诞生了——只要频率记录完好无损，它就能忠实复...

say:22:1320630017:1.text: How did it end up inside Callan's mechanical body? And you mentioned it can record all kinds of sounds...
say:22:1320630017:1.source_cn: 它怎么会被放于铐兰机械躯体的胸中？你说它能记录声音，难道……

say:23:1320630018:1.text: Master Hugin, could it have recorded my brother's voice when he was alive?
say:23:1320630018:1.source_cn: 呼金先生，莫非……莫非它记录了哥哥生前的声音？

say:24:1320630019:1.text: Well, I haven't played it, so it could be anything. It's possible it recorded the lad's last moments, but it also could be an engineering log left by the golem's maker or sounds from the war...
say:24:1320630019:1.source_cn: 可能是小伙子的最后时刻，或者是这具躯体的制造者留下的工...

say:25:1320630020:1.text: Me and the speech loom had a little talk though. It said that if it's for you, it's willing to reproduce the sounds of the past.
say:25:1320630020:1.source_cn: 这小家伙是个好孩子，它说如果是为你，它愿意再现过去的声音。

say:26:1320630021:1.text: So it's up to you, Missy.

say:30:1320630024:1.text: Whatever the speech loom has to say. I'm ready.
say:30:1320630024:1.source_cn: 无论这台小小的织言机将诉说什么，我都做好准备了。

choice:28:0:1.text: Do you want to try it?
choice:28:0:1.male: Do you want to try it?
choice:28:0:1.female: Do you want to try it?

choice:28:2:3.text: You could hear Callan's last words.
choice:28:2:3.source_cn: 铐兰也许为你留下了最后的话
choice:28:2:3.male: You could hear Callan's last words.
choice:28:2:3.female: You could hear Callan's last words.

choice:7:0:1.text: Why doesn't he want to return?
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 他为什么不想回归原来的身体？
choice:7:0:1.male: Why doesn't he want to return?
choice:7:0:1.female: Why doesn't he want to return?

say:32:1320630007:1.text: As I reached for his soul, I could feel that Callan's will was stronger than the soul-binding magic. Essentially, he is still in control, and should he decide, the soul transfer could be completed.
say:32:1320630007:1.source_cn: 拉扯中能感觉到，他的个人意志凌驾于那具躯体上简单粗暴的...

choice:7:1:2.text: Was the soul-binding magic so strong?
choice:7:1:2.male: Was the soul-binding magic so strong?
choice:7:1:2.female: Was the soul-binding magic so strong?
